rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Bear's friendly reminder: exhibition pictures need to follow all 8 of these rules!
rules.when: Submit pictures on Saturday and Sunday. They are displayed all the following week.

r1.title: Sign your picture
r1.text: It's your art — put your signature on it!

r2.title: Color almost all of it
r2.text: Color at least 80% of the picture, with no big white gaps.

r3.title: Color in Free mode
r3.text: Rare card pictures and themed pictures both count, as long as you color them in Free mode.

r4.title: Each picture is shown once
r4.text: This makes room for new pictures.

r5.title: Color neatly
r5.text: Stay inside the lines. A little wobble is okay, but not too much.

r6.title: Keep it happy and friendly
r6.text: No rude, scary, or violent pictures.

r7.title: No bad words
r7.text: Never write a phone number or home address on your picture.

r8.title: Color with your whole heart
r8.text: Don't rush just to get it done.

color.intro: Pick a picture you love and color it beautifully.
steps: Pick an age group, a theme, then a picture.
Choose "Paint by number" (with color hints) or "Free coloring".
Pick a tool (crayon, brush, sticker…) and a color, then start coloring.
Made a mistake? Use Eraser or Undo.
When you're done, tap "Finish" and choose a frame.
Tap "Download" to save it or "Print" to print it.
color.tip: Finished pictures go to your Collection. Unfinished ones are in History.

arena.intro: Compete with other kids — scoring is automatic and fair.
steps: Tap "Find a match" to play with other kids.
Or tap "Create room", send the code to friends, then tap "Start match".
Everyone colors the same picture. Tap "Submit" when done.
Scores are calculated automatically, so it's fair for everyone.
1st place earns +10 points, 2nd +8, and 3rd +6.
Prizes are Rank Points (to move up) and Card Points (to open cards).
arena.tip: Fill the whole picture, mix colors well, and get creative for a high score!

steps: Tap "Create a room" and pick a picture to color together.
Invite friends from your list, or share the room code with anyone.
Invited friends tap "Accept". Others enter the code under "Join a room".
Color together (up to 4 kids) and see everyone's colors instantly.
Tap "Save group picture" and it goes to everyone's Collection and History.
together.tip: The right code gets anyone in, even non-friends, if the room isn't full.

gacha.intro: Use Card Points to open rare picture cards and collect them.
steps: Finish in the Arena's top 3 to earn Card Points.
Every 50 Card Points gets you 1 card.
Tap a glowing card on the stage to flip it, or tap "Open N cards".
There are 4 tiers: S (super rare), A (rare), B (uncommon), C (common).
Cards you open appear under Rare card pictures on the picture page.
Tap a card to color it. The finished picture goes to your Collection.
gacha.tip: You can gift or swap cards with friends on the Friends page.

storybooks.intro: Turn your colored pictures into a storybook of your own.
steps: Tap "New storybook" to open a new book.
Type the title on the cover. Tap "Choose a cover" to change it.
Turn to an inside page and tap "Pick a picture from your collection".
Write under the picture. To add a page, tap "Add new page".
Tap "Save book" to keep it.
Then flip through it, download a PDF, or share it with family.
storybooks.tip: A storybook needs at least 2 pages before you can tap "Finish storybook".

missions.intro: Complete missions to level up and earn Ruby.
steps: Each level has 3 missions. Finish one and get Ruby right away.
Missions include coloring, logging in, making friends, playing in the Arena, and more.
The higher the level, the harder the missions and the more Ruby you earn.
Finish all 3 missions to level up (there are 20 levels).
Spend Ruby in the Shop on pattern colors, frames, and storybook covers.
missions.tip: Avatar frames aren't for sale. You unlock them by ranking up in the Arena.
